g.text: Connect product judgment, meaning and measurement
Faster code creation can move the constraint to review, operations or security.

Laurie Voss’s product-engineer argument follows the bottleneck from code creation to review, operations and security. Observe what users actually do, which handoffs cost time and what they trust. A polished feature can still miss the task or move effort onto another team.

Southbridge’s examples show row counts surviving while dates, signs or categories become wrong. Learn the entity, grain, period, units and source conventions well enough to challenge a plausible answer. Multiple model agreements can preserve the same incorrect assumption.

Convert professional corrections into task definitions, cases, skills and explicit acceptance evidence. Monzo’s described gateway, sandbox and familiar Slack entry point show the surrounding product work. Task volume and merged PR counts indicate use, while quality and reviewer effort still require separate measurement.
Sources: Arize · Southbridge · Monzo | Reviewed October 25, 2026
